market_summary: Across all four instruments, price action remains firmly below session VWAPs and Value Area Lows following early New York session flushes. However, current price action shows low RVOL (all under 0.90) and tight compression directly above major session support levels and lower ATR bands. In XAUUSD, positive GEX dampening above the Gamma Flip further discourages short extensions. All symbols are held pending clear liquidity sweeps or high-volume expansion triggers.
